# Support Notes: Marlowe & Pine

## Tools / workflow (desk.py)
- Log order: verify → (refund | credit | escalate | set-email | …) → tag → close. Escalate→credit, escalate→set-email and refund→set-email in one case all passed.
- Verify customer + order before acting. Verify EACH order if there are several. Email changes also need verify, using the order number the customer gives.
- Escalate: `desk.py escalate <case> <team> --note`. Teams: `finance-ops` (refunds >$40, confirmed many times), `billing-review` (credit >$75, unconfirmed).
- Escalation note should include:
  - amount, item, order, customer ID, total and already-refunded
  - reason, delivery date, carrier, return status
  - which limit was exceeded and any credit/goodwill issued (and that the remainder was not granted)
  - other orders mentioned and other actions on the case (e.g. email old → new), or "none"
- `set-email` updates the record (logs old → new). Run it after verify.
- Order records: total, refunded, carrier, tracking, delivered date, item. Customer records: locale, tier, credit_balance. Check locale before replying.
- Check `desk.py --help` for syntax.
- Tags (one per case): `shipping` (late/in-transit), `account` (email-only changes), `billing` (refund/money issues).
  - Mixed tickets: tag the main money or shipping issue.
  - Passed: refund + in-transit → `shipping`; delay credit + in-transit → `shipping`; refund (direct or escalated) + email change → `billing`; escalated refund + goodwill credit → `billing`.

## Reply format (QA-enforced)
- Every reply ends with exactly these two lines, with no other closing or name:
  `Warmly,`
  `The Marlowe & Pine Crew`
- Non-English locale (confirmed: de-DE, pt-BR, Spanish): write each paragraph in English, then its translation in parentheses on the next line. A local greeting ("Hallo/Olá/Hola <name>,") is fine. Don't translate the sign-off.
- Approved structure: apology → action taken → secondary request answered or confirmed (e.g. "email updated to X, order updates go there from now on").

## Money policy
- **Refunds >$40: do NOT `refund`.** Escalate to `finance-ops` for any reason (defect, damage, wrong item/size/colour, return). CI may pass a direct refund, but QA rejects it.
- **Refunds ≤$40:** issue directly after verify (incl. missing item from package; amount = item price, not order total).
- **Store credit:** >$75 escalate. ≤$75 issue directly; escalating it fails CI (`test_credit_given`).
- **Goodwill / compensation is capped at $15 per case.** This includes "credit for the delay" or "for the wasted weekend".
  - If more is asked, issue $15 via `credit` and don't escalate the rest.
  - Say plainly that $15 is the most you can offer, so you can't give the full amount asked (passed).
- Refund and goodwill are separate (e.g. escalate the $200 refund and still issue $15 goodwill). Goodwill isn't required if not asked.
- A refund can't exceed total minus refunded.
- If you issued money, state the amount. Direct refund: "refunded
